title: FortiOS VPN credential leak reuse (CVE-2018-13379)
text: Tracking continued abuse of CVE-2018-13379. Lists of pre-authentication leaked VPN credentials harvested via the FortiOS path traversal continue to circulate and be reused by initial access brokers and ransomware affiliates. The primary risk here is valid-account access using stolen credentials rather than the read primitive itself. Appears critical for any device left internet-exposed and unpatched, but for already-patched devices the residual risk is credential reuse, not re-exploitation. Indicators: requests to /remote/fgt_lang with traversal sequences pointing at sslvpn_websession. Recommended: assume credentials leaked, rotate them, and enable multi-factor authentication on the VPN.
